text: The owned landing appends the Proton endpoint to the default keyserver list and removes the site-specific WKD path. The checked configured-list consumer reads supported scheme entries; this owned change adds no provider-domain filter to that path. At the fixed comparison revision, the list again has only VKS/Mailvelope and WKD URL creation calls getSiteSpecificUrl before constructing a standard WKD URL. These are two exact source phases. Provider/domain semantics, key correctness and network behavior remain unverified.
title: The Proton default list and WKD route differ between the owned landing and fixed comparison
